text:
Alex: quick handoff — evening sweep. following up on the postmortem items (PM-482): I pushed the remediation checklist to the ticket but TL;DR: 1) patch for kv-cache edge case landed but not promoted to canary, 2) retry backoff tweak deployed to staging, 3) quota leak fix is in a PR awaiting review. can whoever is taking nights verify the canary and run the smoke for the quota fix?

MJ: taking the handoff. can you drop the PR link for the quota fix? also any specific smoke steps?

Alex: PR is https://git.internal/r/PR-7721. smoke steps in the ticket under "validation": curl a few model endpoints, hit embed route with high concurrency, check 429s and the per-customer quota metric. quick command: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" $HOST/v1/embeds; done` — watch `redwood.quota.usage` in grafana.

Sara: fyi I promoted the kv-cache patch to canary at 18:40. no abnormal errors in logs so far. sampling logs: ```container=runtime-3 level=info msg="kv cache warm hit=97.1%"``` :white_check_mark:

Diego: saw a small regression on a different surface earlier today — tokenization mismatch in the reranker smoke that caused a 3% drop in score on eval set. I don't think it's related to these fixes but wanted to flag in case canary shows odd distrib. ticketed as DEV-1298.

MJ: running the quota smoke now against canary. running 50 concurrent requests across 5 clients (quick locust-ish). will post results in ~10m.

oncall-bot: Scheduled job `smoke/quota-check` started by MJ at 2026-03-17T19:12:00Z — job id job-9812.

MJ: smoke run complete. summary: 0 429s observed over 600 requests, mean p95 latency 420ms on canary nodes. captured a few transient 500s early that resolved after retry — stack trace points to transient DB connection pool exhaustion, filing follow-up: INFRA-442. logs: ```2026-03-17T19:18:21Z error db_conn_pool: Acquire timeout```

Alex: thanks — 0 429s is good. MJ can you add the smoke artifacts to PM-482 and link INFRA-442? I'll mark the quota fix PR for merge if reviewers are green.

MJ: added artifacts + linked INFRA-442 and PR-7721. reviewers pinged @Sara @Diego.

Sara: reviewing PR now. small nits about a race in the fallback path, but nothing blocking. leaving comments.

Diego: re the reranker regression — I ran the eval against canary and control. canary shows same tokenization drift as prod; looks unrelated to today's changes. won't block merge but we should consider a quick rollback plan if the regression worsens.

Alex: agreed. plan: merge quota fix, keep kv-cache canary for 4 hours, monitor `redwood.quota.*` and `model.reranker.accuracy`. if reranker degradation >= 2% relative, rollback canary and open immediate postmortem. MJ — please enable autoscaling fallback policy to warm spare nodes for next 2 hours (policy=fast-warm).

MJ: enabled fast-warm, will keep an eye on the dashboards. leaving handoff notes in the handoff doc.

Sara: marking my reviewer approval conditional on nits being addressed. will re-approve once updated.

oncall-bot: Job job-9812 completed: success=1 fail=0 duration=420s. Artifacts uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/9812

Alex: for the night team — if you see more than 2% drift on reranker, ping #eng-ml and escalate to oncall immediately. otherwise keep the canary live until 23:00 PT and we'll do a final sweep. thanks all. :pray:

MJ: noted. passing to night oncall @Diego. good handoff. :thumbsup:

Diego: taking night. I'll run the 1am sweep and report in morning. if anything suspicious I'll reopen PM-482 and escalate.``
